reason: I'm in the car to Jbeil anyway to pick my own vegetables and meat, and Tawfeer MAX is five minutes away, so I can grab the staples in the same trip. Paying $1.25 a bag to save a few cents of half a bulk discount doesn't make sense for me.
objection: I still have to go to Jbeil for fresh food, so what am I saving? The fee could eat the whole saving, and I don't know this neighbour or whether the estimate matches the final bill.
would_change_my_mind: If the slip showed real savings of several dollars a bag, clearly more than the fee, on the items I actually buy, and the first bag was free so I could check it.
